slide.title: change.saga brought current
slide.takeaway: Stale evidence is cleared, superseded proposals retired, merged reviews frozen at their landings, and recent work documented; health is 100%.

item.label: All 122 stale living references cleared
item.description: Each proposal's diff was read: 92 accepted as proposed, 13 re-covered at new lines with the explanation unchanged, 5 terms revised, and 12 removed with the superseded slides they sat on.

item.label: Superseded Proposed slides retired
item.description: Ten technical-inventory Proposed slides described work now implemented. Still-true rationale moved to Implemented Items; their 66 story relations were superseded, and every criterion keeps an explainer.

item.label: Merged reviews report their real range
item.description: Seven reviews following merged branches were frozen at their landings with repin --onto; inventory-query-coverage keeps its recorded base and now follows its head commit.

item.label: Living slides for the recently merged work
item.description: Seven diagram-sourced implementation slides in comparison-history, visual-implementation and documentation-coverage, each Item with exact evidence and an existing criterion it realizes.

item.label: What stays as history
item.description: Eleven validate warnings are merged review decks' historical documentation pins. review-ux-improvements' deck was a partial pass: frozen at its first landing, it explains 637 of 25661 lines.
